newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan gold rates seen steady on low demand.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan gold rates seen steady on low demand.

text.p: Pakistan gold rates are likely to remain steady around current levels with demand low as more players switch into dollars, dealers said on Monday.
They said major players with a longer-term view were switching to the dollar, which has been gaining against other major currencies.
"Their view is that a strong dollar in the international market could force Pakistan to lower its rupee within the next couple of months," one dealer said.

But gold prices would not fall sharply because consumption by jewellers was rising in the marriage season ahead of the Moslem fasting month of Ramadan likely to start in mid-January, the dealer added.
